title: Shop price cards
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: My new home; my room and furniture; describing my appearance and clothes
source: Written for arabic/y5 lesson 3 (Shop price cards (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 3: Bridge: how much is it? Buying food; my body. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: How many?
points: كَمْ تُفَّاحَةً؟ (kam tuffahatan?) how many apples?

cards:
أُرِيدُ خُبْزًا
uridu khubzan
I want bread

كَمْ؟
kam?
how many? how much?

بِكَمْ هٰذَا؟
bikam hadha?
how much is this?
blocks.task: say the Arabic, turn over and check, or play pairs with a partner.
play shop with a partner: one asks بِكَمْ هٰذَا؟ and the other answers with a price card.

questions.q: Say: I want milk. How much is this?
Core: Write a shop dialogue of four lines: greeting, I want ..., how much?, the price.
questions.a: For example: صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ. أُرِيدُ خُبْزًا. بِكَمْ هٰذَا؟ هٰذَا بِخَمْسَةِ جُنَيْهَاتٍ.

questions.q: Extend: Write five body words with their English meaning, then read them to the class, pointing to each part as you say it.
Stretch: Ask how many: كَمْ ...؟ for apples and answer with a number.
How do you ask the price?
questions.a: B) بِكَمْ هٰذَا؟. بِكَمْ هٰذَا؟ means 'how much is this?'.

questions.q: What does أُرِيدُ mean? A) I want B) I have C) I go
Big question: ask for bread and its price in Arabic.
